def _parse_def_item(block: 'BlockParser', m: Match[str]) ->Iterable[Dict[
    str, Any]]:
    text = m.group(0)
    head_text = m.group('def_list_head')
    
    # Parse the head
    head_tokens = _process_text(block, head_text, False)
    for token in head_tokens:
        yield {
            'type': 'def_list_head',
            'children': [token] if token['type'] != 'paragraph' else token.get('children', []),
        }
    
    # Parse the definitions
    # Remove the head text to get just the definitions
    def_text = text[len(head_text):]
    
    # Find all definition blocks starting with `:` marker
    # We need to capture from the `:` marker to the next `:` marker or end of text
    current_pos = 0
    for dd_match in DD_START_RE.finditer(def_text):
        # Get the start of this definition (after the `:` marker)
        start = dd_match.end()
        
        # Find the next definition marker or end of text
        next_match = DD_START_RE.search(def_text, start)
        if next_match:
            end = next_match.start()
        else:
            end = len(def_text)
        
        # Extract the definition content
        item = def_text[start:end]
        
        if item.strip():
            # Check if there's a blank line (loose list)
            loose = bool(HAS_BLANK_LINE_RE.search(item))
            tokens = _process_text(block, item, loose)
            yield {
                'type': 'def_list_item',
                'children': tokens,
            }
